text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Kikuka Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин is in poor shape, and she
drags her
feet as she exits the waiting
room.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Once the gates open, there's nothing
more I can
do to help her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
All I can do is pray that Нарита Таисин
returns in
one piece.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
